                         Project Development Objectives
                         Project Development Objective (from Project Appraisal Document)

                         The objective of the Pacific Regional Connectivity Program is to reduce the cost and increase the availability of international bandwidth for participating countries, and
                         thereby facilitate the development of a wide range of ICT applications to support social andeconomic development in the Pacific region.

                          Phase 1. Tonga-Fiji Connectivity Project: The objective of the proposed Project isto improve the enabling environment for telecommunications and ICT in Tonga,
                         including greater competition and increased access to infrastructure and services by reducing the costs of international connectivity and strengthening the
                         telecommunications regulatory framework. Access to the capacity on this new infrastructure will be available on an open-access basis. Expected sector-specific
                         outcomes are: (a) increased international connectivity; (b) improved enabling environment; and (c) increased access to ICT services.
                         Has the Project Development Objective been changed since Board Approval of the Project?

                            Yes           No

                         Implementation Status Overview
                         The Project was declared effective on November 2, 2011. Overall implementation is progressing satisfactorily with the submarine cable system implementation underway, and set to
                         become operational in July 2013. Component 2, which focuses on strengthening the enabling environment, is also progressing satisfactorily with legal, regulatory and capacity
                         building advisers expected to begin work within the next few months. Component 3, project management, has improved significantly since the previous review. A project manager is
Public Disclosure Copy




                         in place and providing effective support to the implementing entities.

                         Key Decisions Regarding Implementation
                         It was agreed that Tonga will conduct a robust public relations campaign to enhance the visibility of the Project to consumers (individuals and institutions), potential investors (both
                         within Tonga and abroad), ISPs, and any other relevant stakeholders. This would involve the preparation of a marketing strategy for Tonga as an ICT destination, a consumer
                         awareness campaign to ensure that the project is adopted and has the full envisaged impact on the direct beneficiaries, and media events including the preparation of a documentary
                         film about ICT in Tonga. To ensure the success of these initiatives, the Government would need to engage a marketing/communications specialist to support this. These activities will
                         raise the likelihood of PDO achievement.
                         It was also agreed that the Government will review the issue of wholesale Internet pricing in the interest of maximizing the benefits of the new high-speed Internet connection, and
                         also expedite implementation of the legal and regulatory support components.

                         Restructuring History
                         There has been no restructuring to date.
